title: The original selected-minor analytic bound
statement: For the original fixed datum $d$, $\nu\ge0$, height $H>0$, and a column selection with nonzero selected-minor determinant, the normalized logarithmic determinant is at most $d.analyticError+R_d(H)+\max\{-collisionRate_d(H),-\nu((d.A)(1-d.eta)-actualMean_d(H))\}$, with every term and binder exactly as in the source theorem.
